# Call of Doodie — LLM Summary

## What is this?

Call of Doodie (https://callofdoodie.wtf/) is a free browser-based top-down roguelite wave shooter
developed by VaultSpark Studios LLC. It is a comedy parody game and is not affiliated with
Activision Publishing, Inc. or the Call of Duty® franchise.

## Game Summary

- **Genre:** Top-down roguelite wave shooter
- **Platform:** Browser (desktop and mobile) — no install required
- **Price:** Free to play
- **Developer:** VaultSpark Studios LLC (https://vaultsparkstudios.com/)

## Core Loop

1. Choose a callsign (pseudonym) and a starter loadout
2. Survive escalating waves of absurd enemies: Karen, Gym Bro, Mall Cop, Influencer, etc.
3. Earn perk points at wave-clear to build one of four archetypes: Vanguard, Gunslinger, Demolitionist, Tempo
4. Spend 💩 coins at the wave shop on weapons, upgrades, and power-ups
5. Die. Review your run coach debrief. Retry.

## Features

- **Daily Challenge:** Same seed for all players each day with global leaderboard ranking
- **Boss Rush:** Every wave is a boss encounter
- **Gauntlet:** Weekly fixed-challenge mode with stat mutations
- **Speedrun:** Race the clock with a live timer
- **Replay Codes:** 12-character codes to share or replay exact runs
- **Ghost Rivalry:** Challenge friends or leaderboard rivals on identical seeds
- **Replay Trust:** Cryptographic replay command traces for leaderboard integrity
- **Run Coach:** Zero-token AI coaching based on your run history
- **Doodie Pass:** Cosmetic-only seasonal track (never gameplay-gating)

## Technical

- Built with React + Vite, deployed on Cloudflare Pages
- Service worker for offline/PWA support
- Supabase backend for leaderboard and score submission
- PostHog analytics, Sentry error monitoring
